metaDescription: Install .pkg packages from the local server straight to the PS4 via Remote Package Installer.
title: Packages in /packages
subtitle: Pick a .pkg file: the server copies it to the console (GoldHEN FTP, into /data/pkg), then you install it from the Debug Settings menu.
emptyBody: Put the .pkg files in the packages/ folder next to index.html. If the server doesn't list directories, add packages/packages.php — it generates the list automatically on every request.
infoBody: With GoldHEN running, press a package and wait for the “Copied” message. Then open Settings → Debug Settings → Game → Package Installer and install it from the list. Copying is slow (≈0.7 MB/s), so leave the page open. Navigate with the D-pad.
needHost: Fill in the console's IP before installing.
copiedHint: Install it from Settings → Debug Settings → Game → Package Installer.
copyFailedHint: Check that GoldHEN is running (FTP on port 2121) and try again.
notReachableHint: Start GoldHEN, open the Remote Package Installer app and leave it in the background (PS button), then try again.
diagEmpty: empty list (no .pkg files seen in the folder)
diagNoLinks: the received page has no .pkg links (autoindex disabled or index.html in the folder)
